label: Policy / Mission
description: State announces or notifies an AI policy/mission/strategy

label: Institution / CoE
description: State sets up task force / centre of excellence / AI body

label: Partnership / MoU
description: State signs MoU with company / university for AI
example: Gujarat MoU with university for AI lab

label: Governance Deployment
description: State deploys AI in a public service (see sector)
example: AI triage in Tamil Nadu govt hospitals

label: Budget / Funding
description: State budget line or fund earmarked for AI
example: Rs 100 crore for AI in state budget
